_comment: Rough memory estimates for candidate local models at 4-bit, WEIGHTS ONLY (excludes KV-cache, context and scratch, which grow with sequence length and concurrency). For the dashboard's 'what could fit' estimate only; actual admission still needs a verified deployment measured on real hardware (docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md). Numbers are approximate.

index_proxies._doc: Local models in selection (owner 2026-11-13; docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md, 'Local models in selection (published proxy index)'). A model on the owner's Ollama node has no published scores of its own, so each VARIANT borrows the index of its PUBLISHED base model (a name exactly as in tables/benchmarks/scores.csv) minus `deduct` (the owner's copy is quantized and abliterated). tables/benchmarks/build_tiers.py writes them to model-scores.generated.json → local_models with proxy: true and the provenance; provider/routing.py offers a variant wherever its index clears the request's required index, like a cloud model. `id` is the Ollama tag on the node (matched case-insensitively, `:latest` optional). `thinking`: off = the request is sent with thinking disabled; on = thinking enabled with a budget that fits the request, offered only when the request's max_tokens leaves room (local_lane.THINK_MIN_MAX_TOKENS). A measured index (plugged-in benchmarking, a separate plan) replaces the proxy later.

variants.note: Qwen3.8 27B Heretic, Q4_K_M + abliterated: Artificial Analysis 'Qwen3.8 27B (Non-reasoning)', 20.2 intelligence / 44.6 coding, -10%
the same weights with thinking on: Artificial Analysis 'Qwen3.8 27B (Reasoning)', 33.7 intelligence / 68.1 coding, -10%

not_mapped._doc: Pin-only until their published base model is identified with certainty in scores.csv (do not guess: a wrong base model would route real work on a borrowed score).
not_mapped.Huihui_Qwen_9b: 'Huihui Qwythos 9B': a community fine-tune whose base is not stated in its name; scores.csv has qwen3-5-9b, qwen3.5-9B and qwen3-8b, but no Qwen3.8 9B, and which (if any) it derives from is not known
not_mapped.Huihui_Qwen3.8: 'Huihui Qwen3.8 Abliterated (17 GB)': the size suggests the 27B, but the parameter count and whether it is the reasoning or instruct build are not stated
not_mapped.Phi_4: 'Phi-4 Heretic (Q4_K_M, 9.1 GB)': 9.1 GB fits a 14B at Q4_K_M, which is phi-4 but also phi-4-reasoning (not in scores.csv); scores.csv's phi-4 is a candidate, not a certainty
